core_details.description: Death Canyon Road and Trailhead are closed to all use. Start hikes at alternative trailheads such as Granite Canyon, LSR Preserve, and Taggart Lake.
core_details.name: Death Canyon Road and Trailhead

core_details.description: Construction projects underway. Moose-Wilson Road closed between LSR Preserve and Moose. Death Canyon Road and Trailhead closed.
core_details.name: Moose-Wilson Road and Death Canyon Road & Trailhead Construction

core_details.description: Expect a single lane of traffic with up to 15-minute delays, 24 hours a day, seven days a week, from April 1 through late October 2026. No oversized/overweight vehicles (8'6"+ wide, 75'+ long, 80,000 lbs+ gross vehicle weight) will be able to cross.
core_details.name: Traffic Delays - Gardner River High Bridge

core_details.description: Roads and parking areas closed at upper Fort Mason during utilities and seismic retrofit projects. Lots will be fenced and used as staging areas for projects occurring through December 2026.
core_details.name: Parking Closure of Fort Mason Lots Until December 2026
